title: Nanocrystalline Ag 8 SnS 6  and Se-substituted Ag 8 Sn(S 1− x  Se  x  ) 6  with ultralow thermal conductivity for thermoelectric applications
content: Developing soft chemical, facile synthesis routes for semiconducting metal sulfides is important for thermoelectrics. Here, we report a low-temperature solution-phase synthesis of nanocrystalline argyrodites Ag8SnS6 and Ag8Sn(S1−xSex)6 (x = 0.03, 0.05) and their thermoelectric properties. Structural characterisations confirm the formation of phase-pure compounds crystallised in an orthorhombic Pna21 structure. Transport measurements confirm n-type conduction and improved electrical properties with Se substitution. Notably, the Ag8SnS6 exhibit an ultralow thermal conductivity with an average value of ∼0.32 W m−1 K−1. A maximum thermoelectric figure of merit (ZT) of ∼0.25 at 550 K is achieved for Ag8SnS5.82Se0.18, which is comparable to that of the bulk system.
